description: Journal-entry analytics for audit and internal control: Benford first-digit distribution with MAD conformity (Nigrini bands), weekend/Korean public holiday postings, exact duplicates (date+account+amount), amounts just below an approval limit (95-100%), round millions and period-end postings; returns counts and the riskiest entries first. Signals are an order to review, not evidence of fraud or an audit opinion.

approvalLimit.description: Approval limit (KRW); amounts at 95-100% of it are flagged

top.description: How many flagged entries to return (default 30)

name: analyze_journal_entries
title: Analyze journal entries
